location.en: Daybreak Coffee head office, meeting room

goal.en: Pitch Brightway's smart lighting to a growing cafe chain.
goal.zh: 向成長中的咖啡連鎖店簡報 Brightway 的智慧照明。

background: modern cafe company meeting room with a long reclaimed wood table, exposed brick wall, hanging edison bulbs, large industrial windows, potted plants, blank wall screen, afternoon light

intro.en: Daybreak Coffee has eight cafes in Maple Bay and plans to open more. Today, you are giving your first real pitch.
intro.zh: 破曉咖啡在楓灣有八家分店，還打算繼續展店。今天，你要做第一場正式的產品簡報。

intro.en: I'll handle the demo, Kai. You do the talking. Benefits first, features second.
intro.zh: 示範交給我，凱，你負責講。先講好處，再講功能。

intro.en: Welcome, both of you. I've got fifteen minutes, so let's see what you've brought.
intro.zh: 歡迎兩位。我有十五分鐘，來看看你們帶了什麼。

lines.en: The floor is yours. How would you like to start?
lines.zh: 交給你了。你想怎麼開始？

choices.en: Thanks for having us. I'll cover three things today: the system, the savings, and the next steps.
choices.zh: 謝謝邀請我們。今天我會講三件事：系統、省下的費用，以及下一步。
choices.tip: 簡報一開始先說要講哪幾點，聽眾心裡有地圖，比較容易跟上。

choices.en: Thank you. First, let me simply introduce our company's long history and all of our products to everyone.
choices.zh: 謝謝。首先讓我簡單介紹一下我們公司悠久的歷史和所有產品。

lines.en: All of your products? In fifteen minutes? Let's hope it's very simple.
lines.zh: 所有產品？在十五分鐘內？希望真的很「簡單」。

story.en: You spend five minutes on the year Brightway was founded. Mr. Reyes starts doodling coffee cups on his notepad.
story.zh: 你花了五分鐘講 Brightway 的創立年份。雷耶斯先生開始在筆記本上畫咖啡杯。

fail.why: 「簡單介紹一下」直譯成 simply introduce 不自然，英文會說 Let me give you a quick overview.。而且簡報開頭講公司歷史很容易讓客戶失去耐心，先說今天的重點：I'll cover three things today.。

choices.en: Thanks! Our lights are simply the best on the market, and I guarantee they'll double your sales this year.
choices.zh: 謝謝！我們的燈是市面上最好的，我保證今年能讓你們的營收翻倍。

lines.en: Double our sales? With light bulbs? That's quite a promise.
lines.zh: 營收翻倍？靠燈泡？這承諾可真大。

story.en: Mr. Reyes writes "double sales" on his notepad and underlines it twice. Every slide after that is measured against your promise.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生在筆記本寫下「營收翻倍」，還畫了兩條底線。之後的每一頁簡報都被拿來跟這個承諾比較。

fail.why: 一開場就誇下「保證營收翻倍」的海口，客戶只會更懷疑，日後也很難兌現。用具體、可驗證的方式開場：I'll cover three things today: the system, the savings, and the next steps.。

lines.en: Every lighting company tells me they're the best. What actually makes yours different?
lines.zh: 每家照明公司都說自己最好。你們到底有什麼不一樣？

choices.en: The key benefit is that our lights adjust to daylight on their own, so your cafes always feel right.
choices.zh: 最大的好處是我們的燈會自動配合日光調整，讓您的咖啡店隨時都有剛好的氛圍。
choices.tip: The key benefit is... 直接點出客戶得到的好處，比列一長串規格更有說服力。

choices.en: The key benefit is our lights can adjusting itself automatic, follow the sunlight outside the window change.
choices.zh: 最大的好處是我們的燈會自動跟著窗外的陽光變化調整。

lines.en: Sorry, the lights follow... the window? Could you run that by me again?
lines.zh: 抱歉，燈跟著……窗戶？可以再講一次嗎？

story.en: Sam jumps in with the demo before you can try again. Your big selling point gets a little lost in translation.
story.zh: 你還沒重講，山姆就先跳出來做示範。你的最大賣點就這樣有點被淹沒了。

fail.why: can 後面要接原形動詞 adjust，不是 adjusting；主詞是 lights，要用 themselves；副詞是 automatically。說成 Our lights adjust to daylight on their own. 就清楚了。

choices.en: Good question. Actually, our CEO used to be a senior engineer at a very famous tech company, you know.
choices.zh: 好問題。其實我們執行長以前是一家很有名的科技公司的資深工程師喔。

lines.en: Good for your CEO. But what does that do for my cafes?
lines.zh: 恭喜你們執行長。但這對我的咖啡店有什麼用？

story.en: Mr. Reyes is not buying your CEO, only your lights. He glances at the clock on the wall.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生要買的是燈，不是你們的執行長。他瞄了一眼牆上的時鐘。

fail.why: 客戶問「有什麼不一樣」，是想知道對他的好處，不是公司背景。用 The key benefit is... 直接說出客戶能得到什麼。

lines.en: Sounds nice. But I'm a numbers person. What does that mean for us in real terms?
lines.zh: 聽起來不錯。但我是看數字的人。實際上這對我們代表什麼？

choices.en: This means you can cut your lighting bill by about 40 percent. That's roughly 3,000 dollars a year per cafe.
choices.zh: 這代表您的照明電費可以減少約四成，大約每家店每年省三千元。
choices.tip: This means you can... 把功能轉換成客戶的實際收穫，再用具體數字支撐。

choices.en: It's very money-saving. Your electricity fee will become very, very less every month, I can promise you that.
choices.zh: 非常省錢。你們每個月的電費會變得非常非常少，我可以保證。

lines.en: Very, very less? How much less, exactly? I need an actual number.
lines.zh: 非常非常少？到底少多少？我需要實際數字。

story.en: You promise savings but cannot say how much. Mr. Reyes writes "vague" in his notebook.
story.zh: 你保證會省錢，卻說不出省多少。雷耶斯先生在筆記本寫下「模糊」兩個字。

fail.why: 「很省錢」直譯成 very money-saving、「電費變很少」說成 become very less 都不自然，而且沒有數字就沒有說服力。改說 This means you can cut your lighting bill by about 40 percent.。

choices.en: Way better than the others. Honestly, our competitors' lights are junk, and one of their clients nearly closed down.
choices.zh: 比別家好太多了。老實說，我們競爭對手的燈很爛，他們有個客戶差點倒閉。

lines.en: Hmm. I actually know some of those people. Let's stick to your product.
lines.zh: 嗯。其實我認識那邊一些人。我們專心談你們的產品就好。

story.en: Mr. Reyes goes quiet and starts wondering what you will say about Daybreak to your next client.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生安靜下來，開始想像你會在下一個客戶面前怎麼說破曉咖啡。

fail.why: 在簡報中批評競爭對手會顯得不專業，客戶也會懷疑你的人品。專注在自己的價值與數據：This means you can cut your lighting bill by about 40 percent.。

lines.en: Kai, maybe tell them about Lakeside Bakery?
lines.zh: 凱，要不要講講湖畔烘焙坊的案例？

lines.en: Yes, please. Has a business like ours actually used this?
lines.zh: 好啊。有跟我們類似的店家真的用過嗎？

choices.en: Yes. Lakeside Bakery switched last spring, and customers now stay about twenty minutes longer on average.
choices.zh: 有的。湖畔烘焙坊去年春天換了系統，現在客人平均多待了大約二十分鐘。
choices.tip: 引用類似客戶的實際成果，是最有說服力的證據。

choices.en: Yes, but honestly our product is still not very good. We will try our best, so please give us a chance.
choices.zh: 有，但老實說我們的產品還不夠好。我們會盡力的，請給我們一個機會。

lines.en: Not very good? Then why exactly am I listening to this pitch?
lines.zh: 還不夠好？那我為什麼要聽這場簡報？

story.en: Mr. Reyes takes your modesty at face value. Sam stares at the ceiling and quietly packs up the demo.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生把你的謙虛當真了。山姆盯著天花板，默默開始收示範器材。

fail.why: 在台灣自謙是禮貌，但在西方商務簡報中，說自家產品「還不夠好」會被照字面理解。自信地用事實說話：Lakeside Bakery switched last spring, and customers now stay longer.。

choices.en: Yes, there has a bakery used it last year, and their customer was increased a lot after that.
choices.zh: 有，去年有一家烘焙坊用過，之後他們的客人增加了很多。

lines.en: A bakery... was increased? Which bakery, and increased how?
lines.zh: 一家烘焙坊……被增加了？哪一家？增加了什麼？

story.en: Your best success story comes out tangled. Sam steps in to explain it while you take a long sip of water.
story.zh: 你最棒的成功案例講得一團亂。山姆接手解釋，你默默喝了一大口水。

fail.why: 「有一家……」英文要說 There is a bakery that...，不能用 there has；increase 當「增加」時直接用主動：their customers increased。最好說出具體名稱與數字：Lakeside Bakery switched last spring.。

lines.en: All right, I'm interested. So what's the next step?
lines.zh: 好，我有興趣了。那下一步是什麼？

choices.en: We'd suggest a free two-week trial in one of your cafes. Would next Monday work for you?
choices.zh: 我們建議在您其中一家店免費試用兩週。下週一方便嗎？
choices.tip: 簡報結尾提出具體、低門檻的下一步，並直接問時間，讓對方好答應。

choices.en: Just sign the contract today. The price goes up next month, so you'd better decide right now.
choices.zh: 今天就簽約吧。下個月要漲價了，你最好現在就決定。

lines.en: I don't make decisions under pressure. Let's leave it there for today.
lines.zh: 我不在壓力下做決定。今天就先到這裡吧。

story.en: Mr. Reyes politely shows you out. Sam spends the ride back explaining the difference between closing a deal and cornering a client.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生客氣地送你們出門。回程路上，山姆一直在解釋「成交」跟「逼客戶」的差別。

fail.why: 用「下個月漲價」逼對方當場簽約，會讓客戶覺得被施壓。提出低風險的下一步更有效：We'd suggest a free two-week trial. Would next Monday work for you?

choices.en: You can think about it first and give us an answer later. We wait for your good news.
choices.zh: 您可以先考慮看看，之後再給我們答覆。我們等您的好消息。

lines.en: Good news? I haven't decided anything yet. What am I deciding on, exactly?
lines.zh: 好消息？我還沒決定任何事。我到底要決定什麼？

story.en: Mr. Reyes says he will be in touch. Three weeks later, you are still waiting for that good news.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生說會再聯絡。三週後，你還在等那個好消息。

fail.why: 「等您的好消息」直譯成 We wait for your good news. 聽起來像假設對方一定會答應，也沒有提出具體的下一步。簡報結尾要給明確行動：We'd suggest a free two-week trial.。

lines.en: A free trial with real numbers? Now that's something I can take to my partners. Monday it is.
lines.zh: 免費試用，還有實際數據？這我就能拿去說服合夥人了。就約週一。

lines.en: Nicely done, Kai. Clear, short, and no wild promises.
lines.zh: 做得好，凱。清楚、簡短，也沒有亂開支票。

story.en: Mr. Reyes shakes your hand and books the trial on the spot. On the way out, Sam lets you carry the demo kit as a reward.
story.zh: 雷耶斯先生和你握手，當場敲定試用。離開時，山姆「獎勵」你幫忙搬示範器材。

notes.explain: 簡報時用來點出客戶能得到的核心好處。重點放在客戶的收穫，而不是產品規格。

example.en: The key benefit is that your staff never have to adjust the lights.
example.zh: 最大的好處是您的員工完全不用手動調燈。

notes.explain: 把功能或數據轉換成客戶實際能做到的事。搭配具體數字，例如 by about 40 percent，說服力最強。

example.en: This means you can open a new cafe without raising your energy budget.
example.zh: 這代表您開新店時不必增加能源預算。

notes.explain: 簡報開場先預告結構，讓聽眾知道接下來會聽到什麼。也可以說 Here's a quick overview.。

example.en: I'll cover three things today: the problem, our solution, and the cost.
example.zh: 今天我會講三件事：問題、我們的解決方案和費用。

notes.en: simply introduce / We wait for your good news.
notes.zh: 簡單介紹一下／等您的好消息
notes.explain: 這兩句都是中文的直譯。介紹時說 Let me give you a quick overview.；結尾不要只說等好消息，要提出具體下一步。

example.en: Let me give you a quick overview. Then we can talk about a trial.
example.zh: 我先快速說明一下，接著再來談試用。

notes.en: Be confident, not humble or harsh.
notes.zh: 自信，但不自貶也不貶人。
notes.explain: 西方客戶會照字面理解「我們產品還不夠好」這類謙虛話；批評競爭對手也會讓你顯得不專業。用事實和數據建立信心最穩。

example.en: We're proud of our results. Here's what one client achieved.
example.zh: 我們對成果很有信心。這是一位客戶達成的成效。
